title: Question
description: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

acceptedAnswer.title: Accepted Answer
acceptedAnswer.description: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

answerCount.title: Answer Count
answerCount.description: The number of answers this question has received.

eduQuestionType.title: Edu Question Type
eduQuestionType.description: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".

parentItem.title: Parent Item
parentItem.description: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

suggestedAnswer.title: Suggested Answer
suggestedAnswer.description: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.
